name: Weatherford Line
notes: Regional rail to Parker County on the UP Baird Subdivision. Long-range reserve (2.9 trips per $M in the 2026 review), built late for a complete network.

name: Greenville Line
notes: Regional rail to Rockwall and Hunt County on the Dallas, Garland & Northeastern from the Blue Line at Downtown Rowlett. Greenville is outside the model's zones (Hunt County), so its riders are understated.

name: I-35E Express
notes: Express bus in I-35E's managed lanes: Waxahachie - Red Oak - Belt Line (Lancaster/DeSoto) - Zang / Illinois (Oak Cliff) - Union Station. Review 2 (residents): Ellis County gets a frequent link decades before regional rail. Every 7.5 min (review 3, R6).

name: Mesquite Express
notes: Express bus on I-30: downtown Mesquite (Main / Galloway) - Town East - downtown Dallas (Pearl/Arts District), until the Las Colinas-Mesquite Line reaches Main / Galloway. Every city over 150,000 served by about 2040.

name: McKinney Express
notes: Express bus on US-75: McKinney - Allen - the Red and Orange lines at Parker Road, until the Red Line reaches McKinney. Every city over 150,000 served by about 2040. Reaches US-75 from downtown on McDonald Street (SH-5) and Spur 399, timed at street speed there.
